'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
****Ismail Yusuf Baz, commander of [[Hezbollah]]'s coastal sector is assassinated with one civilian killed in [[Ain Ebel]], [[Lebanon]], in an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] airstrike. [https://twitter.com/IDF/status/1780289681524998627 (Israel Defense Forces)] [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240416-top-hezbollah-commander-killed-in-israel-drone-strike-in-southern-lebanon/ (Middle East Monitor)]
**Fourteen Israeli soldiers and four civilians were wounded in drone attacks in [[northern Israel]]. One IDF officer later succumbs.[https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hezbollah-launches-missiles-drones-northern-israel-wounding-14-israeli-soldiers-2024-04-17/ (Reuters)]
***[[Al-Maghazi refugee camp airstrikes]]
****At least 13 people are killed in a strike on a refugee camp in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/04/16/middleeast/maghazi-refugee-camp-strike-gaza-intl-latam/index.html (CNN)]
**[[April 2024 Israeli settler rampages]]
***A mob of [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] in [[Aqraba, Nablus|Aqraba]] kills two [[Palestinians]] in revenge for the killing of [[Israelis|Israeli]] teenager Benjamin Achimeir amid escalating [[ethnoreligious group|ethnoreligious]] violence in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/16/israel-settlers-kill-palestinians-west-bank-gaza (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 Wakeley church stabbing]]
**[[Australia]]n police say that the [[Stabbing as a terrorist tactic|stabbing attack]] at an [[Assyrian people|Assyrian]] church in [[Sydney]] was an [[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] act. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/knife-attack-sydney-church-terror-incident-australia-police-say-2024-04-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**[[India]]n security forces kill at least 29 [[Maoism|Maoist]] insurgents in a major [[counterinsurgency]] operation in [[Kanker district]], [[Chhattisgarh]]. A large quantity of weapons are also seized. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/several-maoists-killed-in-encounter-with-security-forces-in-chhattisgarh-5455181 (NDTV)]
*[[Peacekeeping operations in Nagorno-Karabakh]]
**[[Russia]]n [[peacekeeping|peacekeepers]] begin withdrawing from [[Nagorno-Karabakh]], leaving the region under the full control of [[Azerbaijan]]. [https://caliber.az/post/234168/ (Caliber.az)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] President [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] signs a new army draft law. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-zelenskiy-signs-new-army-draft-law-reinforce-exhausted-troops-2024-04-16/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2023–2024 video game industry layoffs]]
**American video game company [[Take-Two Interactive]] lays off 5% of its workforce. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/take-two-interactive-cut-5-its-workforce-2024-04-16/ (Reuters)]
*[[Argentina]] and [[Denmark]] sign a 2.1 billion [[Danish krone|kroner]] (US$300 million) deal for the sale of 24 [[Royal Danish Air Force]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|F-16 Fighting Falcon]]s to Argentina. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Persian Gulf floods]]
**Heavy rains and flash [[flood]]s affect parts of the [[Persian Gulf]], killing at least 18 people in [[Oman]] and causing travel disruptions in the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/4/16/heavy-rains-kill-18-in-oman-as-flash-floods-lash-uae (Al Jazeera)]
*At least six people are killed and three others are reported missing after a boat capsizes along the [[Jhelum River]] in [[Srinagar]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kashmir-india-boat-capsize-a82ae94e846167e448912a265a7f5af2 (AP News)]
*A fire occurs in [[Copenhagen]]'s 17th-century [[Børsen|Stock Exchange Building]], leading to the collapse of the building's iconic ''Dragespir'' spire. Important [[Denmark|Danish]] artworks including ''[[From Copenhagen Stock Exchange]]'' are safely removed from the building. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-breaks-out-copenhagens-historic-stock-exchange-spire-collapses-2024-04-16/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/apr/16/spire-collapses-fire-copenhagen-historic-stock-exchange (''The Guardian'')]
